Confirms a delivery against order lines. Buyers and admins only. The order moves to
partially or fully received by itself. Refused with 409 when a line would be over-received,
a correction would go below zero, or the order is closed. Receipts cannot be edited or
deleted: correct one with a later entry of negative quantity and a note.

devLogin.description: The dev-only login (development and test configurations only).

google.description: Google sign-in, when it is configured.

token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header.

memberships.description: Active memberships only. Empty for a person who belongs to no company.

id.description: The membership id (not the person id).

name.description: Display name for a new person; defaults to the part of the email before the @.

details.description: Free-form details of the action; null when there are none.

supplierActive.description: False when the supplier was deactivated: the item cannot be chosen for new work.

unitPriceMinor.description: Agreed unit price in integer minor units of the company currency (cents, öre).

supplierId.description: An active supplier of the same company.

unitPriceMinor.description: Integer minor units of the company currency, zero or more.

supplierId.description: Moving an item to another supplier requires that supplier to be active.

ApprovalRoute.description: Null while a draft, and on a draft that was cancelled.

unitPriceMinor.description: Copied from the catalog item when the requisition was saved, in integer minor units.

RequisitionAction.description:
What the signed-in person may do to it now. Submitting a draft can still be refused when
it is incomplete.

costCenterId.description: Null while a draft has no cost center yet.

approvalRoute.description: Null while a draft, and on a draft that was cancelled.

decisionNote.description:
For the requester: the approver's comment, the rejection reason, or why the requisition was
approved automatically. Null when there is none.

actions.description:
What the signed-in person may do to it now. Submitting a draft can still be refused when
it is incomplete.

totalMinor.description: Sum of the line amounts in integer minor units of the company currency.

lines.description: Items of active suppliers. The unit prices are taken from the catalog.

justification.description: May be empty in a draft.

comment.description: Shown to the requester. Optional; blank counts as none.

reason.description: Shown to the requester. Required, not blank.

thresholdMinor.description: Integer minor units of the company currency, zero or more.
Integer minor units of the company currency, zero or more.

token.description: The Expo push token, such as ExponentPushToken[xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx].

unitPriceMinor.description: Set by the buyer when the order was made, in integer minor units.

receivedQuantity.description: Net quantity confirmed by goods receipts so far, 0 up to quantity.

status.description:
Derived from the goods receipts: ISSUED until something is received, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED
while any line is short, FULLY_RECEIVED once every line is complete, CLOSED after a buyer
closes a fully received order.

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, null until the order is closed.

requisitionJustification.description: The requisition's justification, to recognise it by.

totalMinor.description: Sum of the line amounts in integer minor units of the company currency.

catalogItemId.description: An item of the chosen supplier. Each item may appear once.

unitPriceMinor.description: Integer minor units of the company currency, zero or more.

requisitionId.description: An approved requisition of the company that has no purchase order yet.

supplierId.description: An active supplier of the company.

quantity.description: Positive for a delivery, negative for a correction of an earlier entry.

note.description: Optional, up to 500 characters: damage, a shortfall, the reason for a correction.

purchaseOrderLineId.description: A line of this purchase order. Each line may appear once per receipt.

quantity.description:
A whole number, not zero. Positive confirms a delivery; negative corrects earlier entries
and needs a note. The line's net received quantity must stay between 0 and the ordered
quantity.
